name: broker-notes
description: BrokerNotes monorepo — Next.js web app (apps/web), NestJS API (apps/api) and shared logic (packages/shared).

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @broker-notes/shared" "npm run dev -w @broker-notes/api" "npm run dev -w @broker-notes/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @broker-notes/api && npm run build -w @broker-notes/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w @broker-notes/api" "npm run start -w @broker-notes/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run format:check
